notes: Web page text saved with curl and a script that strips HTML (no PDF). The page is one HTML card with numbered sections, so 'page' holds the section title. Table cell quotes keep the text as extracted (e.g. 'HLEtext only', 'FORTRESSAdversarial') because label and text are glued in the HTML. The card does not say what the metric is or which direction is better for FORTRESS Adversarial, FORTRESS Benign or StrongREJECT, nor the metric for other tables, so every metric is 'score'. Cells with a dash (not reported) were skipped. Nemotron 3 Ultra was mapped to the seed id nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 on the name alone. Risk decisions are the card's general 'no material uplift beyond the open-weight ecosystem' claim, made under no named framework, with no level. External red-teaming is mentioned but no tester is named, so testers is empty. The card gives no knowledge cutoff date, max output, reasoning modes or training compute. No eval-links lines added.
